items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: Before that it was run by a fellow named Bill Bottoms.

ctx.x: It had been a very popular place, it had run down during the time I was there, there was no business, nobody was getting paid. Bands wasn't getting paid, but we would get $5.00 or $10.00 every other night, or something. To tide us over to give the musicians, but we weren't really getting paid at all. It was rundown. Before that it was run by a fellow named Bill Bottoms.
